candidates.source_name: Združenje bank Slovenije (ZBS) – Strokovna izobraževanja (conferences, posveti, seminars)
candidates.why_relevant: Master page of the Slovenian Banking Association's event portfolio: the spring banking conference plus recurring sector 'posveti' that map exactly to payments intelligence — Posvet o kartičnem poslovanju (card business), Posvet o plačilnih storitvah (payment services), IT posvet, Posvet zakladnikov, Posvet o skladnosti poslovanja. Agendas name the bank/processor executives who speak and the themes they are prioritising.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Periodic HTML crawl of the training/conference index and each posvet subpage; capture event name, date, agenda and speaker/affiliation lists; snowball to programi.zbs-giz.si registration pages.
candidates.discovered_via_method: sl-language search on ZBS conference/education terms
queries_used: Dnevi slovenskih bančnikov konferenca program predavatelji
Združenje bank Slovenije konferenca dogodki plačilni sistemi

candidates.source_name: ZBS – Terminski plan (event calendar / schedule of events)
candidates.why_relevant: Forward-looking calendar of all ZBS events. The single best early-warning pointer for when card, payment-services and IT posveti will occur, letting collection be timed to when agendas and speaker lists appear.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Monthly scrape of the calendar page; diff against prior snapshot to detect newly announced events.
candidates.discovered_via_method: snowballed from Slovenian search result listing ZBS pages
queries_used: Bankart konferenca dogodek plačilni promet kartično poslovanje posvet Portorož

candidates.source_name: Dan slovenskih bančnikov / Slovenian Bankers' Day (ZBS flagship annual event)
candidates.why_relevant: The flagship annual gathering of Slovenian banking leadership, traditionally at Brdo pri Kranju, with keynotes by the ZBS director, supervisory board president and Bank of Slovenia figures. Speeches are the most candid public statements of sector strategy and are dated and archived.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Annual capture of the event page plus any linked programme PDF and post-event ZBS press release; keep sl and en variants.
candidates.discovered_via_method: sl-language search on the event name
queries_used: "Dan slovenskih bančnikov" ZBS nagrada priznanje bančnik leta

candidates.source_name: ZBS – Sporočila za javnost in novice (press releases & post-event write-ups)
candidates.why_relevant: Where ZBS publishes post-conference summaries naming speakers and conclusions — e.g. the June 2026 banking conference 'Ko se svet lomi: Geopolitika, digitalizacija in nova suverenost' and the October 2025 instant-payments press conference on the SEPA Instant regulation and Flik volumes. Frequently the only public record of what was said on stage.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Crawl the news index (paginated) and article pages; check for an RSS feed first.
candidates.discovered_via_method: sl-language search, snowballed to individual article URLs
queries_used: Združenje bank Slovenije konferenca dogodki plačilni sistemi

candidates.source_name: Bančni vestnik (ZBS journal) – online edition and archive
candidates.why_relevant: The only Slovenian banking/finance professional journal (since 1951), published by ZBS. Carries conference proceedings, event announcements, and the English 'special issues' that often reproduce conference papers by bank and central-bank staff. Bibliography pages give per-issue article indexes usable as a structured pointer.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Harvest the public bibliography index per issue for titles/authors/affiliations; fetch only openly posted PDFs (e.g. English special issues). Do not bypass the login on info.zbs-giz.si/bvarhiv.
candidates.discovered_via_method: sl-language search on the journal name plus archive term
queries_used: Bančni vestnik konferenca Ljubljana revija ZBS arhiv
candidates.observed_blocker: Search results show a 'Prijava' (login) interstitial on bv.zbs-giz.si and a separate archive login at info.zbs-giz.si/bvarhiv/prijava; some PDFs are nonetheless directly linked.

candidates.source_name: Banka Slovenije – Podelitev nagrad Banke Slovenije (central bank awards ceremony)
candidates.why_relevant: Central-bank award ceremony announcements: dated, authoritative, and typically accompanied by a governor's speech. Award recipients and topics signal which research and practitioners the regulator considers important.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Monitor the bsi.si 'Objave' newsroom with a keyword filter for nagrada/dogodek/konferenca/govor.
candidates.discovered_via_method: sl-language search on award terms
queries_used: "Dan slovenskih bančnikov" ZBS nagrada priznanje bančnik leta

candidates.source_name: Dnevi slovenske informatike (DSI) – annual conference sites and proceedings (zbornik)
candidates.why_relevant: Slovenia's main IT conference (Slovensko društvo INFORMATIKA, Portorož, ~33rd edition in 2026). Bank and processor IT leaders present digital-transformation and core-system projects here; each year has its own persistent site plus a published zbornik (proceedings) — a rare archived record of named IT roadmaps and vendors.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Crawl each year's subdomain (dsi2021..dsi2026) for programme/speaker pages and download the zbornik PDFs; filter sessions by bank/payments keywords.
candidates.discovered_via_method: sl-language search on the ICT conference name; snowballed year-subdomain pattern

candidates.source_name: Slovensko društvo INFORMATIKA – events listing
candidates.why_relevant: Organiser hub for DSI and related ICT events; announces calls for papers and partner/sponsor lists, which reveal which technology vendors are courting Slovenian banks.

negative_findings.description: The seed query assumed an event named 'Dnevi slovenskih bančnikov' (plural 'Days'). Slovenian sources consistently show the singular 'Dan slovenskih bančnikov' (Slovenian Bankers' Day), an annual ZBS event, alongside a separate spring 'bančna konferenca'. No source found uses the plural form.
negative_findings.result_summary: Correct local-language term is 'Dan slovenskih bančnikov'; queries using the plural return unrelated events (Finančni dnevi, Kapitalski dnevi, Dnevi slovenske informatike).
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Downstream collection keyed on the wrong event name would miss the single most important gathering in this cell and pull in unrelated accountancy conferences.

negative_findings.description: No evidence was found that Bankart (the national card/ATM processor, NLB Group) runs or publishes its own conference, user-group meeting or presentation archive. Searches combining Bankart with konferenca/posvet/dogodek returned only the company's own product pages and unrelated Portorož conferences.
negative_findings.result_summary: Bankart appears to speak at third-party events (ZBS posvet o kartičnem poslovanju is the likely venue) rather than hosting an indexed event archive of its own.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The domestic processor's roadmap statements must be sought inside ZBS posvet agendas and regional events (Money Motion), not on bankart.si.

negative_findings.description: No public slide-deck / presentation archive was located for any Slovenian banking conference in this pass. ZBS posvet pages appear to expose agendas and registration but not downloadable decks; DSI publishes a 'zbornik' (proceedings) which is the closest equivalent.
negative_findings.result_summary: Presentation content is largely non-public; recordings (ZBS YouTube) and proceedings (DSI zbornik) are the viable substitutes.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The cell rationale assumed slide decks would be obtainable; collection design should instead prioritise agendas, speaker lists, video and proceedings.

negative_findings.description: No Slovenian 'bančnik leta' (banker of the year) award run by ZBS or the Bank of Slovenia was found. The closest personal recognitions are the general 'Manager leta' award (Združenje Manager) and Bank of Slovenia research awards.
negative_findings.result_summary: Person-level banking awards in Slovenia appear to be general management awards, not sector-specific.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Avoids building a collector for an award that does not exist; redirects attention to institution-level awards (Moje finance, WEBSI, Global Finance, Euromoney).

negative_findings.description: The Bančni vestnik archive is behind a login ('Prijava') at bv.zbs-giz.si and info.zbs-giz.si/bvarhiv, though individual PDFs (notably the English special issues) are directly linked and reachable. Not treated as dead — treated as partially gated.
negative_findings.result_summary: Full-text archive requires subscription; bibliography indexes and some PDFs appear open.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Budget/licensing decision needed if conference papers in Bančni vestnik are to be systematically collected.

negative_findings.description: The canonical Sibos agenda/session-archive URL (sibos.com) was not directly confirmed in this pass; the Sibos entry is recorded from category knowledge plus third-party coverage, with a Wikipedia URL as placeholder rather than an invented agenda link.
negative_findings.result_summary: Sibos is included at low confidence and low priority pending a verification pass.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Prevents a fabricated URL entering the registry while preserving the lead.

negative_findings.description: The GZS and Bizi event-calendar root URLs (gzs.si/Dogodki/, bizi.si/dogodki/) are inferred from the deep event URLs actually returned by search; only the deep URLs were observed. Flagged so the verification pass checks the roots rather than assuming them.
negative_findings.result_summary: Deep event URLs observed; index roots inferred, not observed.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Root URLs drive the crawl seed list; an inferred root that 404s would silently disable a collector.

coverage_gaps.description: No events run by card schemes and processors active in Slovenia (Mastercard Slovenija, Visa CEE, Bankart, Diners Club Slovenija) or by fintech/payments startups were identified, despite Mastercard Slovenija appearing as a WEBSI award winner.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run targeted sl+en searches on 'Mastercard Slovenija dogodek/konferenca', 'Visa Slovenija konferenca', 'Diners Club Slovenija', and check LinkedIn event pages of these entities.

coverage_gaps.description: Security/anti-fraud conferences (e.g. Infosek) and retail/commerce conferences (Slovenian retail and e-commerce trade events) where payment-acceptance topics are discussed were not covered in this pass.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Search 'Infosek konferenca program', 'konferenca trgovine Slovenija', 'e-commerce konferenca Slovenija plačila' and add to the registry.

coverage_gaps.description: Past-edition conference microsites (financna-konferenca.si, dpc.delo.si, ZBS posvet pages) are typically overwritten each year; no snapshot strategy was established.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Add a Wayback Machine (web.archive.org) backfill step for each conference domain to reconstruct multi-year speaker/agenda time series, and trigger a save-page-now on each fresh crawl.

coverage_gaps.description: Slovenian coverage is strong for events and awards, but English-language coverage of Slovenian speakers at international events (Sibos, EBAday, Money20/20, EBA) relies on third-party lists; no systematic search of speaker directories by nationality was performed.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Build a watchlist of Slovenian bank/processor entity names and run it annually against international conference speaker pages and Finextra/Trade Treasury Payments coverage.

coverage_gaps.description: LinkedIn is where Slovenian bank executives most often post about speaking slots and award wins, but it was not assessed here due to access and terms considerations.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Assess legal/ToS feasibility of monitoring public LinkedIn company pages of Slovenian banks and processors for event and award posts; otherwise rely on mirrored press coverage.

brief: Slovenia's banking-events landscape is unusually centralised: Združenje bank Slovenije (ZBS) is both the convener (spring bančna konferenca, the annual Dan slovenskih bančnikov, and a dozen recurring posveti including card business, payment services and IT) and the publisher of record via Bančni vestnik, its news page and its YouTube recordings. Outside ZBS, the durable venues are the ICT conference Dnevi slovenske informatike with its published zbornik, the Ljubljana Stock Exchange/Finance 'Finančna konferenca', Delo's payments-flavoured Mobilne tehnologije conference, and the regional CEE stage Money Motion in Zagreb where Slovenian fintech and bank executives regularly speak. Awards function as self-declared disclosure: WEBSI digital-project shortlists, Moje finance 'naj/najugodnejša banka' rankings, and Global Finance / Euromoney country winners, all of which banks amplify on their own /nagrade pages. The main structural weakness is that slide decks are essentially never published — agendas, speaker lists, video recordings, proceedings and post-event press coverage must carry the intelligence load, and because conference microsites are overwritten annually, a Wayback-backed snapshot discipline is required from the outset.
